name: CRTIC clean
description: Apple-sober design system — snow white, soft black, one orange accent.
northStar: Premium and unmistakably CRTIC, never generic. Calm canvas, one earned accent, motion that means something.

rules: No window scroll listener (use IntersectionObserver / GSAP ScrollTrigger / Lenis).
No bounce or elastic on UI.
prefers-reduced-motion: keep opacity/color, drop movement and stagger delays.

snippets.rise: .rise { animation: crtic-rise 750ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both; } @keyframes crtic-rise { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(20px) } to { opacity:1; transform:none } }

dos: Reduced-motion + keyboard fallbacks for any scroll-hijack.
donts: Three-equal-card grids, hero-metric templates, fake dashboards.
Scroll cues, section-number eyebrows, decorative status dots.
